svg.title: The regular signed bound is tested in the anchored derivative budget. The forced signed bound has one nonnegative summable hit-envelope common to all line parameters and configurations. For any weights satisfying (LCN2), these two envelopes give budgets rd bP ′, rd kP ′ on the actual output layout, so (LCN1) gives the activity price in (LCN3). The scalar price follows by applying the linear Hessian reading to the same signed regular source estimate and dividing its paid bound by θ2 i . This explains both the norm and the threshold denominator in (LCN3). The primitive locality, derivative and signed-sum bounds used in this step are the marked integral and source projection estimates of the preceding chapters; no assertion about analytic dependence of a chosen forest or local guide is required.
